bibl.title: Ekphrasis e mythos a confronto nel Vecchio e nel Nuovo Posidippo (P. Mil. Vogl. VIII 309, II 29-32; X 30-33 = epigrr. 13 e 65 S.-St.-W.).
bibl.seg: Luigi Belloni, Ekphrasis e mythos a confronto nel Vecchio e nel Nuovo Posidippo (P. Mil. Vogl. VIII 309, II 29-32; X 30-33 = epigrr. 13 e 65 S.-St.-W.).
bibl.note: Some peculiarities of Posidippus' epigram 13 seem to refer to a regality of Alexander using a symbology of oriental origin, in parallel with epigram 65 and in tune with Lysippus' celebratory sculpture. The text could confirm once more an investiture of the sovereign free from apotheosis.
